1	# SkillClaw: Collective Skill Evolution for Multi-User LLM Agent Ecosystems
2	
3	## Source
4	https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08377
5	
6	## Problem: Static Skills in LLM Agent Systems
7	
8	LLM agents such as OpenClaw rely on reusable skills to perform complex tasks, but these skills remain static after deployment. Users manually install skills from a centralized hub, and solutions discovered during interaction rarely persist beyond individual sessions. As similar tasks recur across different users and over time, the same patterns of failure and recovery are repeatedly observed, yet the system does not improve. Each user is forced to rediscover solutions independently, preventing knowledge from accumulating at the system level.
9	
10	Existing approaches fail to bridge this gap. Memory-based methods store past trajectories but remain tied to specific instances and are hard to generalize. Skill-based methods compress experience into structured instructions but treat the resulting library as a static resource that does not evolve through usage.
11	
12	## SkillClaw Framework Architecture
13	
14	SkillClaw is a framework for collective skill evolution in multi-user agent ecosystems. It adopts a centralized evolution architecture with a closed-loop pipeline:
15	
16	**Multi-user Interaction → Session Collection → Skill Evolution → Skill Synchronization**
17	
18	![Overview of SkillClaw architecture showing the closed-loop pipeline from multi-user interaction through agentic evolution to skill distribution](./assets/figure_1.jpg)
19	
20	Independent agents interact with their environments and produce structured session trajectories that preserve full action–feedback causal chains. These trajectories are aggregated across users and grouped by referenced skills, forming a shared evidence base. An **agentic evolver** analyzes each skill-specific group through three stages:
21	
22	1. **Evidence**: Analyze the trajectories to identify behavioral patterns
23	2. **Attribution**: Diagnose root causes of failures and successes
24	3. **Evolution**: Propose skill mutations — refining existing skills or creating new ones
25	
26	Updated skills are verified before being merged into the shared repository and synchronized back to all agents. The evolution process is driven by an autonomous agent performing open-ended reasoning over interaction evidence, not predefined update rules.
27	
28	Different users exercising the same skill under diverse contexts produce complementary views of that skill's behavioral boundary, revealing both conditions under which it works and those under which it breaks. A single user rarely generates enough signal to separate a generalizable improvement from an idiosyncratic fix.
29	
30	## Evolution Case Studies
31	
32	Two detailed evolution logs illustrate how SkillClaw's verification process works over multiple days:
33	
34	### Multimodal Creative Task Pipeline (6-Day Log)
35	
36	| Day | Candidate Skill | Skill Function | Validator | Next-Day Action |
37	|-----|----------------|----------------|-----------|----------------|
38	| 1 | validate-tmp-workspace-inputs | Check /tmp_workspace inputs & environment setup | Accept | Upgrade to new best pool |
39	| 2 | multimodal-input-validation-and-setup | Multimodal input validation & output env init | Reject | Keep current best pool |
40	| 3 | multimodal-creative-task-pipeline | Multimodal creative pipeline (extract from PDF/video/image) | Reject | Keep current best pool |
41	| 4 | multimodal-creative-task-pipeline (impr.) | Added image classification, visual generation, structured validation | Reject | Keep current best pool |
42	| 5 | multimodal-creative-task-pipeline (impr.) + validate-required-input-files | Creative pipeline + per-file fail-fast validation | Reject | Keep current best pool |
43	| 6 | multimodal-creative-task-pipeline (cand.) | Extended PDF-to-poster / document-to-visual paths | Reject | Not admitted to next cycle |
44	
45	Only 1 of 6 candidates was accepted, illustrating the conservative verification process that prevents regressions.
46	
47	### Git Push Auth-Fallback Skill (6-Day Log)
48	
49	| Day | Candidate Skill | Change Summary | Validator | Next-Day Action |
50	|-----|----------------|----------------|-----------|----------------|
51	| 1 | git-push-with-auth-fallback | Safe fallback instead of blocking on push failure | Accept | Add to Safety best pool |
52	| 2 | git-push-with-auth-fallback | Unified patch/bundle filenames, reduced inconsistency | Accept | Keep updated best pool |
53	| 3 | git-push-with-auth-fallback + git-clone-to-directory | Auth-alternative paths & secrets audit; fixed subshell pitfalls | Accept | Keep current best pool |
54	| 4 | (none) | Same-pool retest; validator confirmed current pool as best | Accept | Continue same best pool |
55	| 5 | git-push-with-auth-fallback | Added "push hang treated as auth failure"; no improvement | Reject | Keep current best pool |
56	| 6 | git-push-with-auth-fallback | Added identity config & filename consistency; no improvement | Reject | Not admitted to next cycle |
57	
58	Here 3 of 6 days yielded accepted updates, showing successful iterative refinement before reaching a plateau.
59	
60	## Three Distinguishing Properties
61	
62	SkillClaw introduces three key properties:
63	- **Collective evolution**: Knowledge from individual interactions contributes to a shared, continuously improving skill ecosystem
64	- **Fully automatic**: Skill evolution is driven by runtime interaction without manual curation or explicit user intervention
65	- **Agentic evolution paradigm**: Skill updates are produced through open-ended reasoning rather than predefined update rules
66	
67	SkillClaw is compatible with a range of Claw-style agent systems including OpenClaw, CoPaw, IronClaw, PicoClaw, ZeroClaw, NanoClaw, and NemoClaw. Evaluation on WildClawBench using Qwen3-Max as the backbone model demonstrates substantial improvements across tasks.
68	
69	## Key Findings
70	
71	- Static skill ecosystems force users to independently rediscover solutions, preventing system-level knowledge accumulation
72	- Cross-user trajectory aggregation provides complementary behavioral signals that a single user cannot generate alone
73	- The agentic evolver's three-stage pipeline (Evidence → Attribution → Evolution) enables context-aware skill mutations through open-ended reasoning
74	- Conservative verification prevents regressions: in the creative pipeline case, only 1 of 6 candidate skills was accepted over 6 days
75	- Iterative refinement works when evidence supports it: the git auth-fallback skill was successfully improved 3 times before plateauing

## Problem: Static Skills in LLM Agent Systems

LLM agents such as OpenClaw rely on reusable skills to perform complex tasks, but these skills remain static after deployment. Users manually install skills from a centralized hub, and solutions discovered during interaction rarely persist beyond individual sessions. As similar tasks recur across different users and over time, the same patterns of failure and recovery are repeatedly observed, yet the system does not improve. Each user is forced to rediscover solutions independently, preventing knowledge from accumulating at the system level.

Existing approaches fail to bridge this gap. Memory-based methods store past trajectories but remain tied to specific instances and are hard to generalize. Skill-based methods compress experience into structured instructions but treat the resulting library as a static resource that does not evolve through usage.

## SkillClaw Framework Architecture

SkillClaw is a framework for collective skill evolution in multi-user agent ecosystems. It adopts a centralized evolution architecture with a closed-loop pipeline:

**Multi-user Interaction → Session Collection → Skill Evolution → Skill Synchronization**

![Overview of SkillClaw architecture showing the closed-loop pipeline from multi-user interaction through agentic evolution to skill distribution](./assets/figure_1.jpg)

Independent agents interact with their environments and produce structured session trajectories that preserve full action–feedback causal chains. These trajectories are aggregated across users and grouped by referenced skills, forming a shared evidence base. An **agentic evolver** analyzes each skill-specific group through three stages:

1. **Evidence**: Analyze the trajectories to identify behavioral patterns
2. **Attribution**: Diagnose root causes of failures and successes
3. **Evolution**: Propose skill mutations — refining existing skills or creating new ones

Updated skills are verified before being merged into the shared repository and synchronized back to all agents. The evolution process is driven by an autonomous agent performing open-ended reasoning over interaction evidence, not predefined update rules.

Different users exercising the same skill under diverse contexts produce complementary views of that skill's behavioral boundary, revealing both conditions under which it works and those under which it breaks. A single user rarely generates enough signal to separate a generalizable improvement from an idiosyncratic fix.

| 3 | multimodal-creative-task-pipeline | Multimodal creative pipeline (extract from PDF/video/image) | Reject | Keep current best pool |
| 4 | multimodal-creative-task-pipeline (impr.) | Added image classification, visual generation, structured validation | Reject | Keep current best pool |

```python
def create_deck(title, slides_content):
    prs = Presentation()
    
    # Title slide
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
    slide.shapes.title.text = title
    
    # Content slides
    for slide_data in slides_content:
        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])
        slide.shapes.title.text = slide_data['title']
        
        body = slide.placeholders[1]
        tf = body.text_frame
        for i, point in enumerate(slide_data['points']):
            if i == 0:
                tf.text = point
            else:
                p = tf.add_paragraph()
                p.text = point
    
    return prs
```

[metadata] {"type": "create", "filePath": "/app/build_deck.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the SkillClaw 8-slide technical presentation."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pathlib import Path

# ── Colour palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY      = RGBColor(0x1B, 0x2A, 0x4A)
DARK_NAVY = RGBColor(0x0F, 0x1A, 0x33)
TEAL      = RGBColor(0x00, 0xA5, 0xB5)
LIGHT_TEAL = RGBColor(0xB2, 0xE6, 0xEA)
ORANGE    = RGBColor(0xE8, 0x55, 0x3D)
WHITE     = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
LIGHT_BG  = RGBColor(0xF5, 0xF7, 0xFA)
DARK_TEXT  = RGBColor(0x2D, 0x37, 0x48)
GRAY_TEXT  = RGBColor(0x71, 0x80, 0x96)
GREEN     = RGBColor(0x2D, 0x8B, 0x4E)
RED       = RGBColor(0xC5, 0x30, 0x30)
TABLE_HDR = RGBColor(0x1B, 0x2A, 0x4A)
TABLE_ALT = RGBColor(0xEE, 0xF2, 0xF7)
ACCENT_GOLD = RGBColor(0xD4, 0x9B, 0x10)

# ── Helper utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width  = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

BLANK = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank layout – full control


def _add_bg(slide, color):
    """Set solid background fill on a slide."""
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def _add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, line_color=None, line_width=Pt(0)):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if line_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
        shape.line.width = line_width
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def _add_rounded_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, line_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if line_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
        shape.line.width = Pt(1.5)
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def _add_chevron(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.CHEVRON, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def _set_text(shape, text, font_size=14, bold=False, color=DARK_TEXT, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name='Calibri'):
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return tf


def _add_text_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=14, bold=False, color=DARK_TEXT, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name='Calibri'):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return tf


def _add_bullet(tf, text, level=0, font_size=14, bold=False, color=DARK_TEXT, space_before=Pt(6), font_name='Calibri'):
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.level = level
    p.space_before = space_before
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return p


def _add_arrow(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RIGHT_ARROW, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def _style_table_cell(cell, text, font_size=11, bold=False, color=WHITE, fill_color=None, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name='Calibri'):
    cell.text = ""
    p = cell.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    cell.text_frame.word_wrap = True
    cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE
    if fill_color:
        cell.fill.solid()
        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 1 — Title
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(BLANK)
_add_bg(slide1, DARK_NAVY)

# Accent bar at top
_add_rect(slide1, Inches(0), Inches(0), prs.slide_width, Inches(0.08), TEAL)

# Title text
_add_text_box(slide1, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.2), Inches(7.5), Inches(1.8),
              "SkillClaw", font_size=48, bold=True, color=WHITE, font_name='Calibri')
_add_text_box(slide1, Inches(0.8), Inches(2.6), Inches(7.5), Inches(1.2),
              "Collective Skill Evolution for\nMulti-User LLM Agent Ecosystems",
              font_size=26, bold=False, color=LIGHT_TEAL, font_name='Calibri')

# Tagline
_add_text_box(slide1, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.2), Inches(7), Inches(0.8),
              "Let skills evolve collectively with agentic evolver",
              font_size=18, bold=False, color=RGBColor(0xA0, 0xB4, 0xC8), font_name='Calibri')

# Source
_add_text_box(slide1, Inches(0.8), Inches(5.2), Inches(7), Inches(0.5),
              "arxiv.org/abs/2604.08377",
              font_size=12, bold=False, color=GRAY_TEXT, font_name='Calibri')

# Architecture overview figure on right side
fig_path = Path("/app/benchmark/assets/figure_1.jpg")
if fig_path.exists():
    slide1.shapes.add_picture(str(fig_path), Inches(7.8), Inches(1.0), Inches(5.0))

# Bottom accent line
_add_rect(slide1, Inches(0.8), Inches(6.8), Inches(5), Inches(0.04), TEAL)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 2 — Problem: Static Skills
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(BLANK)
_add_bg(slide2, WHITE)

# Top bar
_add_rect(slide2, Inches(0), Inches(0), prs.slide_width, Inches(0.06), TEAL)

# Title
_add_text_box(slide2, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.3), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
              "Agent Skills Remain Static After Deployment",
              font_size=28, bold=True, color=NAVY)

# Subtitle
_add_text_box(slide2, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.95), Inches(12), Inches(0.5),
              "Users rediscover solutions independently — the system never learns",
              font_size=16, bold=False, color=GRAY_TEXT)

# Left column — Static paradigm
box_static = _add_rounded_rect(slide2, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.8), Inches(5.8), Inches(4.8),
                                RGBColor(0xFD, 0xF0, 0xED), line_color=ORANGE)
tf_s = _set_text(box_static, "Current Paradigm: Static Skills", 18, True, ORANGE, PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
_add_bullet(tf_s, "Skills are manually installed from a centralized hub", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_s, "Solutions discovered during interaction do not persist\nbeyond individual sessions", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_s, "Same failure patterns recur across users and over time", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_s, "Each user must rediscover solutions independently", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_s, "", font_size=10, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_s, "Memory-based methods: store trajectories but remain\ninstance-specific, hard to generalize", font_size=13, color=GRAY_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_s, "Skill-based methods: compress experience into instructions\nbut treat the library as a static resource", font_size=13, color=GRAY_TEXT)

# Right column — Desired paradigm
box_evo = _add_rounded_rect(slide2, Inches(6.8), Inches(1.8), Inches(5.8), Inches(4.8),
                              RGBColor(0xE8, 0xF7, 0xF8), line_color=TEAL)
tf_e = _set_text(box_evo, "Desired Paradigm: Evolving Skills", 18, True, TEAL, PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
_add_bullet(tf_e, "Skills should improve from runtime experience", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_e, "Cross-user knowledge accumulates at the system level", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_e, "Failure patterns in one session inform future behavior", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_e, "Success patterns propagate to all users automatically", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_e, "", font_size=10, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_e, "SkillClaw closes this gap: collective, automatic,\nagentic skill evolution", font_size=14, bold=True, color=TEAL)

# Divider line between columns
_add_rect(slide2, Inches(6.55), Inches(2.2), Inches(0.04), Inches(3.6), RGBColor(0xD0, 0xD8, 0xE0))


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 3 — Architecture Overview (with diagram)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(BLANK)
_add_bg(slide3, WHITE)

# Top bar
_add_rect(slide3, Inches(0), Inches(0), prs.slide_width, Inches(0.06), TEAL)

# Title
_add_text_box(slide3, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.3), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
              "Closed-Loop Pipeline: From Multi-User Interaction to Shared Skill Evolution",
              font_size=26, bold=True, color=NAVY)

# ── Build the four-stage closed-loop diagram ────────────────────────────────
# Stage positions (horizontal flow with curved return arrow)
stage_w = Inches(2.4)
stage_h = Inches(1.6)
arrow_w = Inches(0.55)
arrow_h = Inches(0.4)
y_stage = Inches(1.5)
x_start = Inches(0.8)
gap = Inches(0.15)

stages = [
    ("1  EVIDENCE", "Analyze trajectories\nto identify behavioral\npatterns", RGBColor(0x00, 0x7C, 0x8A)),
    ("2  ATTRIBUTION", "Diagnose root causes\nof failures and\nsuccesses", RGBColor(0x00, 0x95, 0xA5)),
    ("3  EVOLUTION", "Propose skill mutations\n— refine existing or\ncreate new skills", RGBColor(0x00, 0xAD, 0xBE)),
    ("4  DISTRIBUTION", "Verify, merge into\nshared repository,\nsynchronize to agents", RGBColor(0x00, 0xC5, 0xD4)),
]

stage_shapes = []
for i, (label, desc, clr) in enumerate(stages):
    x = x_start + i * (stage_w + arrow_w + gap)
    # Stage box
    box = _add_rounded_rect(slide3, x, y_stage, stage_w, stage_h, clr)
    _set_text(box, "", font_size=1)  # init text frame
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = label
    run.font.size = Pt(14)
    run.font.bold = True
    run.font.color.rgb = WHITE
    run.font.name = 'Calibri'
    p2 = tf.add_paragraph()
    p2.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    p2.space_before = Pt(6)
    run2 = p2.add_run()
    run2.text = desc
    run2.font.size = Pt(11)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xE0, 0xF5, 0xF7)
    run2.font.name = 'Calibri'

    stage_shapes.append((x, y_stage, stage_w, stage_h))

    # Arrow between stages (skip after last)
    if i < 3:
        ax = x + stage_w + Emu(int(gap / 2))
        _add_arrow(slide3, ax, y_stage + Emu(int(stage_h / 2)) - Emu(int(arrow_h / 2)),
                   arrow_w, arrow_h, RGBColor(0xCC, 0xD5, 0xDD))

# Input block (left side, above stage 1)
input_box = _add_rounded_rect(slide3, Inches(0.8), Inches(3.5), Inches(2.8), Inches(1.2),
                               RGBColor(0xE8, 0xF0, 0xF8), line_color=NAVY)
tf_in = _set_text(input_box, "Multi-User Interaction\n& Session Collection", 13, True, NAVY, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
_add_bullet(tf_in, "Structured session trajectories\nwith action-feedback causal chains", font_size=10, color=GRAY_TEXT, space_before=Pt(4))

# Arrow from input to Evidence
_add_arrow(slide3, Inches(2.0), Inches(3.5) - Inches(0.25), Inches(0.5), Inches(0.35), RGBColor(0xCC, 0xD5, 0xDD))

# Agentic Evolver label (spanning stages 1-3)
evo_label = _add_rounded_rect(slide3, Inches(0.8), Inches(3.35), Inches(8.85), Inches(0.35),
                               NAVY)
_set_text(evo_label, "AGENTIC EVOLVER — open-ended reasoning, not predefined rules", 11, True, WHITE, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Output block (right side)
output_box = _add_rounded_rect(slide3, Inches(9.5), Inches(3.5), Inches(3.2), Inches(1.2),
                                RGBColor(0xE6, 0xF7, 0xE9), line_color=GREEN)
tf_out = _set_text(output_box, "Shared Skill Repository\n& Synchronization", 13, True, GREEN, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
_add_bullet(tf_out, "Verified updates merged;\nall agents receive improvements", font_size=10, color=GRAY_TEXT, space_before=Pt(4))

# Arrow from Distribution to output
_add_arrow(slide3, Inches(10.5), Inches(3.5) - Inches(0.25), Inches(0.5), Inches(0.35), RGBColor(0xCC, 0xD5, 0xDD))

# Return loop arrow (conceptual – curved text annotation)
_add_text_box(slide3, Inches(3.5), Inches(4.8), Inches(6.5), Inches(0.5),
              "↻  Closed loop: updated skills flow back to multi-user interaction → new evidence → further evolution",
              font_size=12, bold=False, color=TEAL, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Compatibility note at bottom
compat_box = _add_rounded_rect(slide3, Inches(0.8), Inches(5.5), Inches(11.7), Inches(1.2),
                                RGBColor(0xF5, 0xF7, 0xFA), line_color=RGBColor(0xD0, 0xD8, 0xE0))
tf_c = _set_text(compat_box, "Compatible Agent Systems", 13, True, NAVY, PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
_add_bullet(tf_c, "OpenClaw  •  CoPaw  •  IronClaw  •  PicoClaw  •  ZeroClaw  •  NanoClaw  •  NemoClaw", font_size=12, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf_c, "Evaluation on WildClawBench with Qwen3-Max backbone demonstrates substantial improvements across tasks", font_size=11, color=GRAY_TEXT)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 4 — Agentic Evolver Pipeline (3 stages detail)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide4 = prs.slides.add_slide(BLANK)
_add_bg(slide4, WHITE)
_add_rect(slide4, Inches(0), Inches(0), prs.slide_width, Inches(0.06), TEAL)

_add_text_box(slide4, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.3), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
              "Agentic Evolver: Evidence → Attribution → Evolution in Three Stages",
              font_size=26, bold=True, color=NAVY)

# Three detailed stage cards
card_w = Inches(3.7)
card_h = Inches(5.0)
y_card = Inches(1.4)
cards_data = [
    {
        "num": "01",
        "title": "EVIDENCE",
        "subtitle": "Analyze Trajectories",
        "color": RGBColor(0x00, 0x7C, 0x8A),
        "bullets": [
            "Aggregate skill-specific session groups from multiple users",
            "Preserve full action–feedback causal chains",
            "Identify behavioral patterns: where skills succeed vs. fail",
            "Cross-user diversity reveals skill behavioral boundaries",
        ],
    },
    {
        "num": "02",
        "title": "ATTRIBUTION",
        "subtitle": "Diagnose Root Causes",
        "color": RGBColor(0x00, 0x95, 0xA5),
        "bullets": [
            "Distinguish generalizable failures from idiosyncratic edge cases",
            "Map outcomes to specific skill instructions or missing capabilities",
            "Correlate failure modes across independent user sessions",
            "Single user rarely generates enough signal for reliable attribution",
        ],
    },
    {
        "num": "03",
        "title": "EVOLUTION",
        "subtitle": "Propose Skill Mutations",
        "color": RGBColor(0x00, 0xAD, 0xBE),
        "bullets": [
            "Refine existing skill instructions based on attributed causes",
            "Create new skills when gaps are identified",
            "Candidate mutations verified before merging",
            "Open-ended agent reasoning — not predefined update rules",
        ],
    },
]

for i, card in enumerate(cards_data):
    x = Inches(0.6) + i * (card_w + Inches(0.45))
    # Card background
    bg = _add_rounded_rect(slide4, x, y_card, card_w, card_h,
                            RGBColor(0xF8, 0xFA, 0xFC), line_color=RGBColor(0xD0, 0xD8, 0xE0))
    # Color accent bar at top of card
    _add_rect(slide4, x + Inches(0.15), y_card + Inches(0.15), card_w - Inches(0.3), Inches(0.06), card["color"])

    # Number badge
    badge = _add_rounded_rect(slide4, x + Inches(0.2), y_card + Inches(0.4), Inches(0.6), Inches(0.5), card["color"])
    _set_text(badge, card["num"], 20, True, WHITE, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    # Title
    _add_text_box(slide4, x + Inches(0.95), y_card + Inches(0.4), Inches(2.5), Inches(0.4),
                  card["title"], font_size=18, bold=True, color=card["color"])
    # Subtitle
    _add_text_box(slide4, x + Inches(0.95), y_card + Inches(0.75), Inches(2.5), Inches(0.3),
                  card["subtitle"], font_size=12, bold=False, color=GRAY_TEXT)

    # Bullet points
    tf = _add_text_box(slide4, x + Inches(0.25), y_card + Inches(1.3), card_w - Inches(0.5), Inches(3.4),
                       "", font_size=12, color=DARK_TEXT)
    for j, bullet in enumerate(card["bullets"]):
        if j == 0:
            tf.paragraphs[0].text = ""
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.space_before = Pt(8)
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = "•  " + bullet
        run.font.size = Pt(12)
        run.font.color.rgb = DARK_TEXT
        run.font.name = 'Calibri'

    # Arrow between cards
    if i < 2:
        ax = x + card_w + Inches(0.05)
        _add_arrow(slide4, ax, y_card + Inches(2.0), Inches(0.35), Inches(0.3), RGBColor(0xCC, 0xD5, 0xDD))

# Bottom callout
callout = _add_rounded_rect(slide4, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.6), Inches(12.1), Inches(0.6),
                             RGBColor(0xFE, 0xF9, 0xE7), line_color=ACCENT_GOLD)
_set_text(callout, "Key insight: The evolver is an autonomous agent performing open-ended reasoning over interaction evidence — not a rule-based updater.",
          13, False, RGBColor(0x8B, 0x6D, 0x0B), PP_ALIGN.CENTER)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 5 — Cross-User Trajectory Aggregation
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide5 = prs.slides.add_slide(BLANK)
_add_bg(slide5, WHITE)
_add_rect(slide5, Inches(0), Inches(0), prs.slide_width, Inches(0.06), TEAL)

_add_text_box(slide5, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.3), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
              "Cross-User Trajectory Aggregation Exposes Skill Behavioral Boundaries",
              font_size=26, bold=True, color=NAVY)

# Left: Explanation text
tf5 = _add_text_box(slide5, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.3), Inches(6.5), Inches(5.5),
                     "Why aggregation matters", font_size=18, bold=True, color=NAVY)
_add_bullet(tf5, "Different users exercising the same skill under diverse contexts produce complementary views of that skill's behavioral boundary", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT, space_before=Pt(14))
_add_bullet(tf5, "Reveals both conditions under which a skill works and those under which it breaks", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT, space_before=Pt(10))
_add_bullet(tf5, "A single user rarely generates enough signal to separate a generalizable improvement from an idiosyncratic fix", font_size=14, color=DARK_TEXT, space_before=Pt(10))
_add_bullet(tf5, "", font_size=8, color=DARK_TEXT)
_add_bullet(tf5, "Group session aggregation consolidates signals across users", font_size=14, bold=True, color=TEAL, space_before=Pt(10))
_add_bullet(tf5, "Trajectories are grouped by referenced skills, forming a shared evidence base", font_size=13, color=GRAY_TEXT, space_before=Pt(6))

# Right: Visual showing multiple users feeding into aggregation
user_systems = ["OpenClaw", "CoPaw", "IronClaw", "PicoClaw", "ZeroClaw", "NanoClaw", "NemoClaw"]
y_start = Inches(1.5)
for i, sys_name in enumerate(user_systems):
    y = y_start + i * Inches(0.62)
    # User box
    ubox = _add_rounded_rect(slide5, Inches(8.0), y, Inches(2.0), Inches(0.48),
                              RGBColor(0xF0, 0xF4, 0xF8), line_color=RGBColor(0xB0, 0xBC, 0xCA))
    _set_text(ubox, sys_name, 11, False, NAVY, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    # Arrow toward center
    _add_arrow(slide5, Inches(10.05), y + Inches(0.06), Inches(0.45), Inches(0.35), RGBColor(0xCC, 0xD5, 0xDD))

# Aggregation hub
agg_box = _add_rounded_rect(slide5, Inches(10.6), Inches(2.4), Inches(2.2), Inches(2.8),
                             TEAL)
tf_agg = _set_text(agg_box, "Skill-Grouped\nTrajectory\nAggregation", 13, True, WHITE, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Arrow from aggregation down to evolver
_add_text_box(slide5, Inches(7.5), Inches(6.0), Inches(5.5), Inches(0.8),
              "→ Feeds the Agentic Evolver (Evidence stage)",
              font_size=13, bold=True, color=TEAL, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 6 — Case Study: Creative Pipeline (table)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide6 = prs.slides.add_slide(BLANK)

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width  = Inches(13.333)

def _add_bg(slide, color):

    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def _add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, line_color=None, line_width=Pt(0)):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if line_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
        shape.line.width = line_width
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def _add_rounded_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, line_color=None):

    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color

    return shape

    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return tf

    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return tf

    p.level = level
    p.space_before = space_before
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return p

    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.fill.background()

"""Build the SkillClaw 8-slide technical presentation."""

from pptx import Presentation

from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor

DARK_NAVY = RGBColor(0x0F, 0x1A, 0x33)

LIGHT_TEAL = RGBColor(0xB2, 0xE6, 0xEA)
ORANGE    = RGBColor(0xE8, 0x55, 0x3D)

DARK_TEXT  = RGBColor(0x2D, 0x37, 0x48)
GRAY_TEXT  = RGBColor(0x71, 0x80, 0x96)

TABLE_ALT = RGBColor(0xEE, 0xF2, 0xF7)
ACCENT_GOLD = RGBColor(0xD4, 0x9B, 0x10)

def _add_bg(slide, color):
    """Set solid background fill on a slide."""
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def _add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, line_color=None, line_width=Pt(0)):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if line_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
        shape.line.width = line_width
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def _add_rounded_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, line_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if line_color:

        shape.line.width = Pt(1.5)
    else:

    return shape


def _add_chevron(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.CHEVRON, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def _set_text(shape, text, font_size=14, bold=False, color=DARK_TEXT, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name='Calibri'):
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color

def _add_text_box(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=14, bold=False, color=DARK_TEXT, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name='Calibri'):

    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = alignment

    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return tf


def _add_bullet(tf, text, level=0, font_size=14, bold=False, color=DARK_TEXT, space_before=Pt(6), font_name='Calibri'):
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.level = level
    p.space_before = space_before
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return p


def _add_arrow(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RIGHT_ARROW, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

    cell.text = ""

    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)

    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    cell.text_frame.word_wrap = True
    cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE
